hotels.title: Japan Mountain Onsen Escape with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Cocktails & JPY10,000 Credit
hotels.description: Once a restorative stop for travellers crossing the old Tokaido road, this mountain town still draws visitors for its natural hot springs - and Hyatt Regency Hakone Resort and Spa brings the tradition right to your stay, with an onsen fed by Owakudani’s volcanic waters. Just 90 minutes from Tokyo, Hakone trades city streets for cherry blossoms in spring, green mountain trails in summer, fiery autumn foliage and snow-dusted peaks in winter. For a cultural detour, the Hakone Open-Air Museum’s sculpture-filled grounds are a short shuttle ride away. Back at the hotel, book a treatment at Spa IZUMI or claim a seat by the Living Room’s open fireplace. Seasonal sushi and French cuisine await at the hotel’s restaurants, while the Hakone Open-Air Museum is a short shuttle ride away. For a stay that puts you close to the real rhythms of Japan’s onsen country, this is a compelling place to check in.
